info.name: anubanDaviSezaH
info.value: 1.936 glAsnAvanuvamAM ca iti gaRasUtreRa upasargasya anupasTitO vikalpena mittvam .

info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to be tired, to wane, to be fatigued, to be exhausted

info.name: hindI arTa
info.value: mlAna honA, glAniyukta honA, jamhAI lenA

examples: 'nAnuDyAyAd bahUYCabdAnvAco viglApanaM hi tat' (CAM0 u0). viglApanaM vyayaH, apakzayaH.
'tanno viglApayati' (BA0 pu0 3.2.22). viglApayati Kedayati, vimanAyayati, vimanaskAnkarotItyarTaH.
'paryAdayo glAnAdyarTe caturTyA' iti vArtike pariglAno'DyayanAya paryaDyayana ityudAharaRaM sTitam. aDyayane'naBiruciranutsuko'samarTa ityarTaH.
